productScope.objective: Ship SDGallery V2 as a stronger learning product with guided paths, richer diagrams, and better contributor workflows while keeping the current Next.js + MDX architecture.

successMetrics.name: Pathway clarity
successMetrics.description: Beginner visitors can start a guided path without hitting dead ends.
successMetrics.target: One beginner-ready path is fully navigable from entry to completion

successMetrics.name: Content discoverability
successMetrics.description: Readers can find relevant concepts and case studies through the new taxonomy.
successMetrics.target: At least three distinct taxonomy pillars and two learning paths are published

successMetrics.name: Contributor confidence
successMetrics.description: Contributors can add new content with fewer manual decisions.
successMetrics.target: Templates and validation rules exist for required metadata

guidingPrinciples: Keep content-first workflow with Markdown and MDX in the repository.
Prefer progressive enhancement over a rewrite.
Raise quality with validation and automation, not process overhead.
nonGoals: A full CMS or database-backed editor
